products.description:
Deliver and manage Android apps through managed Google Play

On Android Enterprise, apps flow through managed Google Play — and doing it well means the right app types, configs, and update control. This solution covers Android app management in Intune: approving and assigning store, private (LOB), and web apps via managed Google Play, managed app configuration, app protection policies, update/track control, and per-enrollment-model assignment — so users get the apps they need, configured and controlled.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — app types on managed Google Play (store/private/web), managed configuration, protection, and update-track control across enrollment models.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise + managed Google Play binding, admin roles, app sources).
  • Implementation Guide — approve + assign store/private/web apps, apply managed configurations + app protection, set update tracks, and target by enrollment model / group — pilot-first, each app/config named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (apps deliver, configs apply, updates controlled) plus Best Practices for a governed managed Google Play app catalog.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Android apps delivered right — store, private, and web apps approved and assigned, configured, protected, and update-controlled through managed Google Play — users equipped, IT in control.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ANDROIDAPP-AppProtection.ps1 — list Android app protection (APP/MAM) policies, or stage a baseline one (read/-WhatIf by default, Graph)
    • ANDROIDAPP-AssignConfig.ps1 — stage a managed Google Play app assignment (intent/track/auto-update) and report managed-config attachment (-WhatIf by default, Graph)
    • ANDROIDAPP-Discovery.ps1 — inventory managed Google Play apps + assignment posture (read-only, Graph)
    • ANDROIDAPP-Scope.ps1 — managed Google Play binding + app-sync health and scope pre-flight (read-only, Graph)
    • ANDROIDAPP-Validation.ps1 — per-app delivery/config/protection/track validation report (read-only, Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
